N_eff_scope: Weight-only Kish N_eff, not independent samples. Prompt/article N_eff aggregates row weights before applying Kish formula; correlated tokens do not create new articles.

numeric_contract.feature: gather x/shared_z; F32(F32(raw-center)*inv_scale); whole-vector A8; source shared Down unchanged
numeric_contract.fit: weighted ridge on actual F32 QDQ(A8(transformed features)); TRAIN-only transformations/subsets/bias
numeric_contract.readout: row-W8 and whole-vector A8: F32 amax/127, zero scale=1; F32 quotient then round ties away from zero to [-127,127]; exact integer dot; F32(dot) * F32(weight_scale * input_scale); separate F32 bias addition. FP diagnostic: stored F32 coefficient, FP64 dot, cast F32 then F32 bias; not the C++ FMA reduction contract.
numeric_contract.selection: minimum VALID selected-alpha-squared-weighted NMSE; all-row scores also retained
numeric_contract.TEST: not accepted or opened by this program
